records.title: FedSODA: Federated Fine-tuning of LLMs via Similarity Group Pruning and Orchestrated Distillation Alignment
records.reason: FedSODA prunes similar/redundant layers into a sub-LLM (SGP), uses partial/intermittent distillation alignment (ODA), and QLoRA for federated fine-tuning of LLaMA3-8B, Qwen2-7B and Mistral-7B. Experiments report lower client storage/communication and comparable fine-tuning accuracy. The measured goal is training/client adaptation, not inference latency, cache, or serving, so relation to the current scope is weak and borderline.
